dogecoin.text: @LetCoins @dogecoin @Shibtoken I think my point here is we can’t just draw 2 random lines on a 4 day graph and state that the coin is trending to be worthless. There is a MUCH bigger picture here and new ground is being broken daily in the crypto world.

@LetCoins @dogecoin @Shibtoken We have to respect that crypto is still very new. I firmly believe crypto is an inevitable future of finance, so just wait til just 10% of the global population is invested. And then 20, and then 30. The crypto landscape is going to be VERY different.

@LetCoins @dogecoin @Shibtoken These alt coins are here to stay and I guarantee a few of them will level out the market in a very good way for their investors. Especially with more and more block chains coming out. Bitcoin created the market, yes, but it won’t control it much longer

@LetCoins @dogecoin @Shibtoken But crypto is NOT just two coins and with more and more people getting into crypto, they see that. Right now, yes, Bitcoin drives the market. But crypto has less than 4% of the worlds population invested. Wait til that goes up just another 2%…
@LetCoins @dogecoin @Shibtoken I also feel like you’d be pretty hard pressed to not find that exact pattern in any other successful coin’s history. But again, I’m not here to do the work for you.
@LetCoins @dogecoin @Shibtoken I mean the fact you have both lines going through two bull flags alone is pretty silly, but I’m not here to do the work for you.
@LetCoins @dogecoin @Shibtoken It’s awesome when people draw lines on a graph they don’t understand lol
